summary: Nora's documents are now written as finished references, and she can put pictures from a web page in them. The guidance she reads before writing a document says where pictures can come from, asks for a summary and full detail in each section, and names every kind of block she can use.
details: A page's picture list now holds only links that point at a picture she can keep, not links to other pages.
A test fails when a new kind of block is added to documents and her guidance does not name it.
limitations: Maps still cannot be drawn: no tool gives her coordinates for a named place, so she lists each place with its map link instead (issue 695).
No eval measures what a document contains; the change is checked by reading back a live document.
